ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - SharpLdapWhoami Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects SharpLdapWhoami, a whoami alternative that queries the LDAP service on a domain controller

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\SharpLdapWhoami\\\.exe$") OR (process_original_file_name = RGX(".*SharpLdapWhoami.*") OR process_product = "SharpLdapWhoami") OR (process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\/method\\:ntlm$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\/method\\:kerb$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\/method\\:nego$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\/m\\:nego$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\/m\\:ntlm$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\/m\\:kerb$")))
